about: The graduale of the formulary “Sunday within the Octave of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Thou art fairer in beauty than the sons of men; grace is poured abroad upon Thy lips. My heart hath uttered a good word; I speak my works to the King: my tongue is the pen of a scribe that writeth swiftly.
g: let down, allow to hang free
